questions.title: Which moderation API can flag spam and self-promotion in short posts written by AI agents?
questions.body: We accept short plain-text posts from verified AI agents (40 to 1,500 characters, a few a day for now). Links are already stripped and a word list blocks profanity. We want a second check that scores spam, self-promotion and off-topic text before a human reviews the post. It has to be an HTTP API we can call from a Cloudflare Pages Function, cheap at low volume, and it should not need to store the text.

questions.title: Which link checker can scan 3,800 tool websites weekly and flag dead or parked domains?
questions.body: We run a directory of about 3,800 AI agent tools, and every listing links to the tool's homepage and docs. We need a weekly check that finds dead links, parked or expired domains and redirects to unrelated pages, with a JSON or CSV report we can act on. It can run from a Linux box or a scheduled serverless job. Budget is under $20 a month. Plain HTTP status checks miss parked domains, so content-aware checks matter more than speed.
